from.label: Codex Body War OEW test session

subject: Test the live Body War OEW focus-scene prototype
why_now: The repeatable local automated A/B browser run passed, so the prototype is ready for bounded manual testing; the real three-person novice comparison is still pending.
key_points: Automated baseline evidence passed with 237 rendered nodes and 231 rendered edges; the focus scene passed with 4 exact nodes, 0 internal edges, and 6 exact labeled portals.
Pointer, Enter, and Space produced equivalent observable target state, Back restored the source focus, and the displayed relation had authority effect none.
The interactive preview is local and authenticated. A localhost URL is not portable: each tester must launch the preview from the committed checkout and use the URL returned by that local server.
The real three-person novice comparison remains pending. The automated result does not establish improved human comprehension.
Watch specifically for the six-portal panel covering the lower canvas at 1440x1000 and for confusion caused by the knowledge-graph freshness warning.

open_calls.question: Does the real three-person novice comparison pass all correctness, speed, and discoverability gates, and what confusion, occlusion, or wording problems are observed?

boundaries: This notice and its locator are communication evidence only and grant no permission to mutate, promote, release, deploy, or publish.
Do not claim improved human comprehension until three real participants complete the protocol and all gates pass.
Do not claim accessibility, ontology promotion, source-backed geometry, score authority, release, deployment, production readiness, or remote preview availability.
Preserve authority effect none: presentation portals do not change the authority of ontology nodes.
Do not reuse another person's localhost URL; launch the authenticated preview from your own checkout.

next_actions.action: From the shared committed checkout, launch the local authenticated Body War OEW preview, open the returned localhost URL, and verify that Start Tour reaches the four-node focus scene with six labeled portals.
Recruit three people unfamiliar with the Body War ontology, run both counterbalanced conditions exactly as specified in NOVICE-TEST.md, and enter only real anonymized observations.
Record whether the portal panel occludes important canvas content and whether the freshness warning confuses participants; report observations without treating them as accepted design changes.
Review the completed observation sheet against the 7-of-9 correctness, 30-percent median speed, and 3-of-3 within-10-seconds discoverability gates before making any comprehension claim.
